capabilities: Search five scholarly databases from free text, DOI, arXiv ID or URL
Create source notes from templates with metadata placeholders
Download and embed open-access PDFs in or outside the vault
Insert citations from existing source notes
Open papers for reading in the Web viewer or browser
extras: Desktop-only (not available on mobile because saving PDFs outside the vault uses desktop file access); requires Obsidian 1.13.2+. Status is 'early release' with beta installs via BRAT. All five data sources are free and need no account; Semantic Scholar is rate-limited without an API key.
intentEvidence: No account and no reference manager are needed. Everything stays in Obsidian.
problem: Finding a paper from fragmentary information (a half-remembered title, DOI, arXiv ID or URL) and turning it into a properly filled source note requires leaving Obsidian and juggling databases and a reference manager.
summary: Research paper search tool that queries OpenAlex, arXiv, INSPIRE-HEP, Crossref and Semantic Scholar and saves papers as source notes with optional PDFs.
